name: Haus Mark
beschreibung: The Haus Mark enjoys a peaceful and sunny location in Nesselwängle, right in the heart of the picturesque Tannheimer Tal. The warmly decorated alpine-style guest rooms feature balconies overlooking the surrounding Allgäu Alps, private bathrooms with shower/WC, and satellite television. Each morning begins with a nutritious breakfast made from fresh regional ingredients. The property is ideally placed for nature lovers: summer offers an abundance of walking, hiking, and cycling trails, alongside swimming and boating at nearby Lake Haldensee. In winter, groomed cross-country tracks pass by the village and the local ski area provides fun on the snow for all skill levels.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy guesthouse in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal featuring traditional rooms and close proximity to Lake Haldensee.
